lines: This world, or friends, or kin —
naught of mine. But Thou art all this again — then who else be mine?
sanskrit_cite: jagad idam athavā suhṛdo bandhujano vā na bhavati mama kim api tvaṃ punar etat sarvaṃ yadā tadā ko 'paro me 'stu

lines: 'Master, Great-Lord — Thou outright; all the world Thee alone' —
may the thing itself ripen: this the begging — and therein begging alone.
sanskrit_cite: svāmin maheśvaras tvaṃ sākṣāt sarvaṃ jagat tvam eveti vastv eva siddhim etv iti yācñā tatrāpi yācñaiva

lines: Three-worlds-lordship even here seems straw to Thy partaker.
What fruit has fair-deed, Lord, parted from remembering Thee?
sanskrit_cite: tribhuvanādhipatitvam apīha yat tṛṇam iva pratibhāti bhavajjuṣaḥ kim iva tasya phalaṃ śubhakarmaṇo bhavati nātha bhavatsmaraṇād ṛte

lines: Since naught of worlds nor world-birth is parted from Thee —
Thy unfolding: 'mid marvel-deeds even rises no praise-weaving of Thee.
sanskrit_cite: yena naiva bhavato 'sti vibhinnaṃ kiñcanāpi jagatāṃ prabhavaś ca tvadvijṛmbhitam ato 'dbhutakarmasv apy udeti na tava stutibandhaḥ

lines: 'Thine-made am I, Thy-worship-bound' —
ever, unceasing picturing, All, by own sap — dream-goer even: why am I not so?
sanskrit_cite: tvanmayo 'smi bhavadarcananiṣṭhaḥ sarvadāham iti cāpy avirāmam bhāvayann api vibho svarasena svapnago 'pi na tathā kim iva syām

lines: Brushed by a jot even — Thy-foot-lotus-born scent-speck —
for them rest-like turns all joy-kind, gods-hunted even.
sanskrit_cite: ye manāg api bhavaccaraṇābjodbhūtasaurabhalavena vimṛṣṭaḥ teṣu visram iva bhavati samastaṃ bhogajātam amarair api mṛgyam

lines: Heart: naught but Thee. Word and deed: wholly else, Kind One.
From the truly Real — grace or curb: one alone be wrought.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdi te na tu vidyate 'nyad anyad vacane karmaṇi cānyad eva śaṃbho paramārthasato 'py anugraho vā yadi vā nigraha eka eva kāryaḥ

lines: Dull am I, pain-laden am I, age-fearing am I, power-bare am I —
Thine-sheltered am I. Kind One, so ordain: swift I near the highest yoke, sorrow-road-forsaken.
sanskrit_cite: mūḍho 'smi duḥkhakalito 'smi jarādidoṣabhīto 'smi śaktirahito 'smi tavāśrito 'smi śambho tathā kalaya śīghram upaimi yena sarvottamāṃ dhuram apojjhitaduḥkhamārgaḥ

lines: Couched at Thy ear-place, my wails, most trifling, take high worth —
as reed-joint-fallen water-specks wear pearlhood.
sanskrit_cite: tvatkarṇadeśama dhiśayya mahārghabhāvam ākranditāni mama tucchatarāṇi yānti vaṃśāntarālapatitāni jalaikadeśakhaṇḍāni mauktikamaṇitvam ivodvahanti

lines: What, pray, is unwon, alas — even by such as dote a wink, by cheat even, on Thy name?
Cool-ray-crested, so act that I, death-wounded, may reach minuteness-and-the-rest as glory.
sanskrit_cite: kim iva ca labhyate bata na tair api nātha janaiḥ kṣaṇam api kaitavād api ca ye tava nāmni ratāḥ śiśiramayūkhaśekhara tathā kuru yena mama kṣatamaraṇo 'ṇimādikam upaimi yathā vibhavam

lines: Kind One! Śarva! Moon-crested! Śiva! Three-eyed rosary-wearing! Glorious! Fierce-skull-signed! Grim-trident-flashing! Pity-sea!
Worlds-weaving-natured! Fierce-power-formed! Fair-throated! — swift destroy ill-luck's loads; lay on high Thine own ripening.
sanskrit_cite: śambho śarva śaśaṅkaśekhara śiva tryakṣākṣamālādhara śrīmann ugrakapālalāñchana lasadbhīmatriśūlāyudha kāruṇyāmbunidhe trilokaracanāśīlograśaktyātmaka śrīkaṇṭhāśu vināśayāśubhabharān ādhat svasiddhiṃ parām

lines: What, Lord, would not be, where the Lord wins not makerhood? What being had the knower, unmade by Kind-Maker?
Thus ever sheltered in Thee — unwaning great power's High-Lord — here in passing, pang-thickened, I ail — alone.
sanskrit_cite: tat kiṃ nātha bhaven na yatra bhagavān nirmātṛtām aśnute bhāvaḥ syāt kim u tasya cetanavato nāśāsti yaṃ śaṅkaraḥ itthaṃ te parameśvarākṣatamahāśakteḥ sadā saṃśritaḥ saṃsāre 'tra nirantarādhividhuraḥ kliśyāmy ahaṃ kevalam

lines: Though pains, age, death here — haughtiest boon-lords — bide a wink; approved, sounds and the rest, unstable ever —
yet I hanker, ever-joy-hungering, to stand long for life-drink: joy-taste-yoked Thy-foot-lotus-thought, first.
sanskrit_cite: yady apy atra varapradoddhatatamāḥ pīḍājarāmṛtyava ete vā kṣaṇam āsatāṃ bahumataḥ śabdādir evāsthiraḥ tatrāpi spṛhayāmi santatasukhākāṅkṣī ciraṃ sthāsnave bhogāsvādayutatvadaṅghrikamaladhyānāgrya jīvātave

lines: O Lord — skilled smasher of the bent one's pangs, weal-hoard, Matted-haired —
of me, pain's sole seat, birth-death-frighted, now so act: living even, Thy-worship-bound, I win unshaken ripenings, sweet-sense-taste-yielding, high.
sanskrit_cite: he nātha praṇatārtināśanapaṭo śreyonidhe dhūrjaṭe duḥkhaikāyatanasya janmamaraṇatrastasya me sāmpratam tac ceṣṭasva yathā manojñaviṣayāsvādapradā uttamā jīvann eva samaśnuve 'ham acalāḥ siddhīs tvadarcāparaḥ

lines: Bow to delusion's great-gloom-smasher of no other work —
to all-light-outshining light, moon-badged.
